description: Na₄Mg(WO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Mg and six O atoms. The Na-Mg bond length is 2.33 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Mg and six O atoms. The Na-Mg bond length is 2.33 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.52 Å. Mg is bonded to four Na and four O atoms to form distorted MgNa₄O₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. All W-O bond lengths are 1.82 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgNa₄O₄ tetrahedra. All W-O bond lengths are 2.04 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one W atom.
